title: Fix S Plugin Build for Framework OS Dev
description: The s-plugin crate fails to compile in framework-os-dev:dev because it imports MeasureSelectItem and WindowEngagementStatus via semio_framework_plugin::component::layout, which no longer exists after the layout components moved into ui_wgpu and are re-exported flatly by semio_framework_plugin. Fix the imports and verify the s app works end to end via the dev server.
summary: Made the s app work end to end via framework-os-dev. Fixed the s-plugin compile error (MeasureSelectItem/WindowEngagementStatus moved to flat re-exports from semio_framework_plugin after the component::layout module moved into ui_wgpu). Fixed five DagError-to-JsValue conversions in framework_surface_node_graph. Rebuilt stale paint/tiled-map/terrain engine wasm pkgs whose artifacts predated the crate renames. Guarded AppDefinition.terminologyDocuments accesses in the React shell (field is skip-serialized when empty, crashing FrameworkOsShell on boot). Guarded the studio setActiveExample handler against the shell's empty-exampleId reset, which navigated to /studios/ and broke studio routing. Fixed the shared Mode dock component so prop-driven layout resyncs never echo through onLayoutChange — a session switch reconciled new windows against the stale layout prop and wrote a pruned empty layout back into the shell, permanently blanking the studio workspace. Reclassified home actions createStudio/importStudio/deleteVirtualFileSystemNode from shell_action to operation since they emit catalog ops (shell-kind actions must not emit operations), fixing Meta+n studio creation. Improved the generated plugin worker to serialize wasm ComponentError payloads into error messages. Fixed two duplicate declarations in the renderer introduced by the concurrent consolidation and the moved Media re-export path in semio-framework-plugin. Updated the studio e2e (case-insensitive home gate, label-based checkpoint palette assert, wait for workspace after VFS double-click). Full verify e2e passes: home boot, Meta+n studio creation, three studio windows, draw spawn, undo, command/find palettes, home-bar navigation, VFS double-click open.
